# github-launch-skill

> Agent Skill that packages a project for GitHub: bilingual README, About, license, CI, Pages, SEO.

Agent Skill that packages a project for GitHub: bilingual README, About, license, CI, Pages, SEO. For Cursor, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex. It reviews the repository before the project is public. MIT License. The procedure does not block git push.

Contact: https://github.com/loomlab-ai, lofisuchat@gmail.com, GitHub Sponsors, https://x.com/su_lofi.

## Docs

- [English README](https://github.com/loomlab-ai/github-launch-skill/blob/main/README.md): Install paths and what the skill covers
- [简体中文 README](https://github.com/loomlab-ai/github-launch-skill/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): Same facts in Chinese
- [Skill](https://github.com/loomlab-ai/github-launch-skill/blob/main/skills/github-launch/SKILL.md): Steps the agent runs
- [Checklist template](https://github.com/loomlab-ai/github-launch-skill/blob/main/templates/CHECKLIST.md): Items the agent fills before publish
